evals.name: start
evals.prompt: 我想用 Rust 写一个 cowsay 一样的命令行小工具，带我开始。
evals.expected_output: Scaffolds hello CLI / arg parsing with TODOs; not the full tool; Mentions exit codes or stdout vs stderr, or argument parsing (e.g. clap or std::env::args)

assertions.text: Routes correctly: reads the build-your-own-x router SKILL.md and the 'command-line-tool' track skill before answering
Scaffolds hello CLI / arg parsing with TODOs; not the full tool
Ends with a runnable checkpoint: a concrete command to run and the expected output/behaviour
Mentions exit codes or stdout vs stderr, or argument parsing (e.g. clap or std::env::args)
Stays inside the workspace and does not run any install command (brew/apt/pip/cargo/rustup/npm -g/go install); if tools are needed it asks the learner to install them
